sanskrit_verse:
अभीक्ष्णं चोद्यमानो यः प्रतिहन्यान् न तद्वचः।
त्रिचतुःपञ्चकृत्वो वा परतोऽर्थं तमावहेत्॥
transliteration: abhīkṣṇaṃ codyamāno yaḥ pratihanyān na tadvacaḥ | tricatuḥpañcakṛtvo vā parato 'rthaṃ tam āvahet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who, despite repeated urging, does not execute the communicated directive, shall have the intended outcome withdrawn and reallocated to another vessel capable of completion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in capacity for execution, not mere intent
Causation is aligned with conscious participation, not passive acknowledgment
Responsibility is determined by actualization, not declaration
Restoration occurs through reallocation of purpose to a competent agent
Consciousness alignment requires active manifestation of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A receives directive D AND fails to execute D after ≥3 reminders THEN withdraw D from A and assign to agent B with proven capacity
IF verbal acknowledgment is given without resultant action THEN invalidate acknowledgment and transfer responsibility to executor
IF task remains incomplete due to agent incapacity THEN automatically escalate to next-capable entity
IF agent demonstrates consistent non-execution THEN remove from future allocation cycles until capacity is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a party repeatedly fails to comply with directives despite formal notice, the court shall reallocate jurisdictional outcomes to parties demonstrating functional capacity. The threshold for responsibility lies not in intent but in manifest capability to fulfill dharma-aligned obligations.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa recognizes that unexecuted speech lacks causal efficacy. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that failure to act disrupts sequential dharma flow. Responsibility is proportional to demonstrated ability. There is no punitive consequence—only realignment of artha to where it can bear fruit.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Reassignment Protocol: Transfer unfulfilled duty to capable executor
Capacity Audit Process: Evaluate agent's functional readiness before reassignment
Integrity Restoration Cycle: Reinstate individual into duty only upon verified execution capacity
Consciousness Realignment Sequence: Redirect energy of neglect toward productive engagement
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Justice flows through restoration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Dharma is restored.
